name: T&T - Combat Assistant
description:
# T&T - Combat Assistant

**Less bookkeeping. More Action.**

Created by: [AmadeusVF](https://app.roll20.net/users/15900768/amadeusvf) - [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/AmadeusVF)

Bring your D&D battles to life with **Combat Assistant**, a powerful Roll20 companion for **D&D 2014 and 2024** character sheets. Keep rolling from the sheets you already use while Combat Assistant turns supported attacks, spells, damage, healing, saving throws and initiative into interactive tools for GMs and players.

**Cast spells, resolve hits, account for resistances, vulnerabilities and immunities, heal allies, manage concentration, track movement and resources — and keep the adventure moving.**

## Features in Chat-Based Menus

- **Detailed action and spell lists:** Quickly access attacks, bonus actions, special actions, reactions and spells from supported character sheets.
- **Prepared spell options:** Filter spell lists to show prepared spells where supported.
- **Compact Character Sheet:** Roll ability checks, skills, saving throws and other supported checks directly from chat.
- **Automatic damage and healing:** Resolve attacks against AC, calculate damage interactions and update HP or Temporary HP on tokens.
- **Interactive buttons for GMs and players:** Select targets and apply supported attacks, healing and spell effects without manually editing token values.
- **Area of Effect tools:** Place movable templates for cubes, cones, lines, spheres and other supported shapes, then resolve affected targets.
- **Custom Spell Templates and Macros:** Customize area markers, attach Apply/End commands and run supported spell macros during the casting workflow.
- **Advanced Turn Tracking:** Interactive Turn Cards, turn order controls, round counting, visual turn markers and optional automatic focus.
- **Concentration Tracking:** Monitor active spells, persistent areas, concentration saves and supported durations.
- **Movement Tracking and Blocking:** Track movement, account for Dash and optionally warn or restrict movement during combat.
- **Resource and Spell Slot Management:** View limited-use abilities and spell slots, with optional automatic resource consumption when supported.
- **Group Initiative and Saving Throws:** Resolve rolls for multiple tokens using supported native-sheet rolls or Combat Assistant roll tools.

## Actions, Spells and a Compact Sheet — Right in Chat

Stop searching through several character sheets during a busy encounter. Combat Assistant brings supported **attacks, bonus actions, special actions and spells** into organized, detailed chat menus. Players can quickly find what their characters can do, while GMs can access useful actions for NPCs without interrupting the session.

The **Spells** menu provides convenient access to spell details and spellcasting controls, including prepared-spell filtering where supported. The **Compact Sheet** puts skill checks, ability checks and other common rolls a click away, without replacing the familiar Roll20 character sheet.

## Automatic Damage, Healing and Area Spells

Combat Assistant reads supported rolls made from your existing Roll20 character sheets and turns them into **interactive combat cards**. With the appropriate settings enabled, it can check attacks against AC, account for resistances, vulnerabilities and immunities, calculate saving-throw damage, and apply damage or healing directly to target tokens.

For **Area of Effect spells**, place and move visual markers on the map, identify affected creatures and resolve their saving throws and damage. Use custom Spell Templates and Apply/End Macros to personalize spell effects and automate supported follow-up actions.

## Advanced Turn Tracking

Know whose turn it is and what they can do next. Combat Assistant can keep Roll20's Turn Order moving with **interactive Turn Cards**, a **Round Counter**, visual **Turn Markers** and optional camera focus on the active token.

Turn Cards can give players quick access to combat actions, spells and resources. Players can advance turns they control, while the GM retains control over the encounter and turn management.

## Concentration, Resources and Movement

**Concentration Tracking** helps manage active spells, persistent areas, concentration saving throws after damage and supported spell durations. Spend less time remembering which effect belongs to which caster.

**Resource Management** brings spell slots and limited-use abilities into chat and Turn Cards, with optional automatic consumption for supported actions. Both player characters and NPCs can benefit from these controls.

**Movement Tracking** follows how far a token moves during its turn, adjusts available movement for Dash and can warn about or restrict movement based on your combat settings. This helps keep tactical encounters organized without constant manual calculations.

## Make Combat Look and Feel Great

- **Visual effects:** Add optional animated FX for attacks, projectiles, area spells, healing and Temporary HP.
- **Customizable experience:** Adjust combat automation, range checks, privacy, condition markers, turn behavior and visual effects to fit your group's play style.
- **Language support:** Play in English or load community translations through a Roll20 handout.

## Get Started

**`!ca menu`** — Open the main Combat Assistant menu and explore its tools.

**`!ca combat`** — View attacks and combat actions from the selected character sheet.

**`!ca sheet`** — Open the compact character sheet with convenient controls.

**`!ca spells`** — Browse and use spells from the selected character sheet.

**`!ca resources`** — View character resources, limited-use abilities and spell slots.

**`!ca init`** — Roll initiative for the selected token.

**`!ca turncard`** — Open the full interactive Turn Card for a character you control.

**`!ca help`** — Discover more commands, features and guidance.

Most actions are available through interactive menus and chat buttons, so you can focus on **the encounter, not the bookkeeping**.

*Features and automation depend on the character sheet, campaign settings and available Roll20 data. The GM can choose which automation tools to enable.*
